## Vesta 1.2.2

### Changes

- New Walk Bot tab in Misc: the bot walks routes over the map's navigation mesh like a player, with jumps, crouch jumps, ladders, doors and breakable glass, boards and vents.
- Random routes stay inside the map and vary from walk to walk; recorded routes are played per map and side, and can be shown on the map.
- Hunt Enemies: the bot heads for a known enemy, then goes back to its routes.
- The bot holds its crosshair at head height on the corner the nearest enemy would come round and switches between corners calmly.
- Its own aim for fights: an enemy in view (106°) is turned onto quickly and smoothly and tracked on the head; autofire uses the trigger bot's settings; hits from unseen enemies get a quick turn towards them; spawn-protected enemies are walked round.
- Auto Buy with presets per mode (premier, competitive, wingman, casual, deathmatch), items by buy-menu code with a side and a money condition; deathmatch buys right after a respawn without a main weapon.
- Auto Reload, Auto Rejoin (mode, side, popups, weekly drop) and Auto Disconnect after a score and a time on the server.
- Aimbot flicks follow a human hand: time grows with the angle, smooth start and stop, no jump in one tick.
- Aim, trigger and Lua input stay off while a game menu is open.
- CPU and GPU priority of the overlay in Misc → Overlay → Engine: game first, balanced or overlay first.
- World lines (routes, bomb safe zone) no longer wave at some view angles.
- Chams and ESP no longer cover the screen when spectating a player.
- Misc tabs rearranged: game binds and support in General, interface, engine and overlay in Overlay.
